Assignments will be posted on Canvas as well as on the course website on the [Assignments](home_assignments.qmd) page. All the assignments must be submitted via Canvas. All assignments require the use of the **Quarto template** provided.  

- 🔗 [Quarto Template](https://github.com/course-page-url/template)
